verdict.rationale: ObsessionDB says it lets you "compute your bill before you talk to us" and compare it one-to-one with current managed ClickHouse spend, which points to a self-serve bill estimator. The free dev tier limits (up to 4 vCPU, 8 GB RAM, no credit card) are also documented. However, the pack contains no actual price rates, so it is unclear how clearly a workload maps to a monthly bill. The free cost audit is a sales-assisted route rather than documented pricing. Missing for 10: published per-unit pricing (compute, storage, egress), documentation of how the bill calculator works, pricing for production/BYOC tiers, independent corroboration that estimates match real bills.
